title: Salt Silence
subtitle: A desert that keeps its scent close
line: From the door the white floor looks empty; up close, the salt is full of hidden scent.
synopsis: You step onto a white salt crust that runs almost wall to wall, and at first the room seems to hold nothing at all. A single pale monolith stands in the middle, rough as a block cut from a dry lake. As you walk the loop around it, four low mounds of wax rise out of the salt, and in their cracks you find small bottles tucked away like seeds. The only sound is your own steps on the crust, and the scent arrives only when you lean in.
quote: Nothing is shown. Everything is near.

why.t: The room first reads as empty
why.d: A 14 x 9 m salt field fills the floor with nothing above knee height except one monolith.

why.t: One monolith gives the eye a place
why.d: The salt block stands at the centre of the field; the route loops around it at 1.6 m.
Four wax clusters sit just outside the loop, low at 0.8 m, so you crouch to find the bottles.
The pay counter sits on the back edge of the salt, facing the loop's far point.

stops.sub: White salt to the walls, and one pale block in the middle.

stops.cap: I lean in and the salt smells of something.
stops.sub: A small bottle is tucked into the crack of a wax mound.

stops.cap: From behind, the monolith casts no sound.
stops.sub: Only my steps on the crust, and the scent I carry.
